bullets: Wifi function and APP remote control: Wifi smart Water valve can connect to 2.4Ghz, without gateway, you can quickly open/close the water valve on the app, and the mobile phone monitors the water flow rate and water consumption in real time. Even on vacation or at work, you can monitor in real time.

Ultrasonic flow detection: Adopts W-type ultrasonic water flow measurement technology, which is accurate and reliable. Users can set water flow rate alarms, and automatically open and close the water valve when the water flow rate is lower or higher than the set value. For example, if a water pipe bursts, the water valve can automatically close, thereby saving water and protecting your home water safety.
Smart Water Meter:Monitor water usage with daily, monthly and last usage statistics, helping you manage water more efficiently and reduce waste.

Easy Installation:Requires 5V/2A AC power adapter for power supply, and equipped with long-life backup battery to avoid power outages and inability to control the water valve. Automated scenes for use with water leak detectors: Through the Tuya app, users can set up scenes to work with the Tuya WiFi Water leak detector(sold seperately), such as automatically shut off a valve when a water leak is detected.

Smart Leak Protection & Remote App Control:Never worry about water damage again. Customizable High/Low Flow Alerts:Complete control over your plumbing health. Set personalized threshold alerts for abnormally high flow (burst pipes) or extremely low flow (potential pipe freezing).
